comment: A Join on a plate's end made in the Extrude panel (GitHub #126, mitcad#1243), tools/ui-join-mesh-reuse-test.sh: a sketch (F1) on the xy plane with a 177.2 x 25 rectangle (c1..c4, c2 its right side at x = 177.2) and, on that side, a 6 x 25 one of three lines (c9, c12, c15). The UI test extrudes the large profile 5 mm (F2.b0) and then the small one 12 mm into it.
